artworks.title: Plan and Part of the Elevation of the Church of the Holy Sepulchre of the Madonna
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [restrike]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural plan and cutaway perspective. The drawing shows a detailed plan of a building with labeled sections. The legend in Italian indicates terms such as 'Altare' (altar) and 'Sepolcro' (sepulcher). The upper section of the drawing illustrates a cutaway view of the interior space with vaulting, pillars, and ascending steps. The drawing aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the floor plan and spatial dimensions of the structure.

artworks.title: Plan and Rendering of the Temple of Solomon
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [restrike]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural design for a domed building. The drawing features a hexagonal building with a dome on top. The top part of the illustration shows an isometric view of the building with a domed roof, small windows, and a central entryway. Beneath this, there is a floor plan illustrating a circular arrangement of elements inside the structure, with square and rectangular forms suggesting columns or seating around a central nucleus. The drawing includes clear lines, shading, a compass rose at the bottom right of the plan, and Italian text beneath the isometric view that references the "Tempio di Salomone."

artworks.title: Dedication Plate
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [restrike]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of classical figures and symbols. In the center is a seated woman wearing a flowing robe and holding a shield with a winged horse. Above her is a reclining muscular figure amidst swirling clouds, holding a bundle. To the side, another figure holds a large scroll with text. Ribbons with inscriptions are present. The artwork has intricate shading and linework, creating depth and texture. The composition suggests movement and drama.

artworks.title: Il Greco in Troia: Plate 1
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [restrike]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image displays a view framed through an ornate stone archway. Closest to us are intricately detailed trees on either side of the arch. The scene beyond includes a cityscape with towers, domes, and clustered buildings. The brushwork is finely etched, providing texture to both the trees and the architecture. The color palette is monochromatic, utilizing variations of brown. At the base of the arch, figures dressed in classical armor and robes are engaged in discourse.

artworks.title: Il Greco in Troia: Plate 2
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [restrike]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a classical architectural setting with a horse statue. The scene includes urban environments with large classical buildings and a horse statue on a rectangular pedestal. Various classical structures with columns and decorative facades are visible in the distance against a clear sky. The artwork features detailed line work and shading, resembling classical architectural engravings.

artworks.title: Il Greco in Troia: Plate 3
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [restrike]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand architectural setting with soldiers engaged in a battle. The scene is detailed with classical architectural elements, including columns on either side and a wide staircase leading up to a gated area. The columns feature intricate capitals and fluted shafts. Statues are positioned along the staircase. In the foreground, armed soldiers with helmets, shields, and spears are positioned as if in a conflict. Some soldiers appear to be in motion, suggesting a battle scene. The composition is symmetrical, emphasizing the grandeur of the architecture and the chaos of the army skirmish.

artworks.title: Il Greco in Troia: Plate 4
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [restrike]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large wooden horse being moved through a city. The scene captures a historical or mythological event, where a group of armored individuals is transporting an enormous horse statue on a wheeled platform. The drawing shows a detailed depiction of the surroundings with trees on either side, and a cityscape composed of buildings with varied architectural designs in the background. The sky is lightly filled with clouds. The detailed line work and shading give the drawing a three-dimensional effect, with attention focused on the grandiose scale of the horse in contrast to the human figures around it.

artworks.title: Il Greco in Troia: Plate 5
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [restrike]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people dancing under a canopy in a scenic outdoor setting. The trees frame the scene on both sides, with a stone building visible on the left. In the distance, hills and what appears to be a village or castle can be seen. The detailed linework and sepia color palette give the image an antique look.

artworks.title: Il Greco in Troia: Plate 6
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [restrike]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a grand, intricately decorated interior space. The image showcases an opulently designed room with elaborate architectural details, such as richly patterned walls, ornate moldings, and intricately carved panels. The ceiling features decorative beams with scrolling patterns and leaf motifs, while the walls are adorned with pilasters and round portraits or medallions set above doorways. The wooden plank floor adds to the room's grand aesthetic, with light and shadow playing across it, indicating an external light source casting angular shadows into the room. This detailed rendering highlights the grandeur and artistic richness of the architectural elements.

artworks.title: Il Greco in Troia: Plate 7
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [restrike]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a horizon showcasing hills and houses among the trees. There are lines of trees and structures further in the distance. The artwork features detailed linework and etching, emphasizing texture and depth. The color scheme is sepia and black. In the foreground, there is a small structure with a seated figure and a rider on horseback. A wooden bridge spans a river, leading the eye to trees on the opposite bank.

artworks.title: Il Greco in Troia: Plate 8
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [restrike]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior scene. The design depicts an ornate interior with classical columns and arches, a detailed ceiling with artwork, and an altar-like structure in the center background. The ceiling is adorned with decorative patterns and motifs, accentuating the grandeur of the scene. The space conveys a sense of grandeur and opulence, with the columns and artwork leading the eye towards the central focal point.

artworks.title: Il Greco in Troia: Plate 9
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [restrike]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand architectural interior with classical columns and arches. The scene features intricately detailed columns forming a vaulted arcade, with shadowed arches leading into a distant hall. The architecture is adorned with decorative sculptures and balustrades at the upper levels. The foreground includes intricate detailing, adding depth and contrast to the scene.

artworks.title: Il Greco in Troia: Plate 10
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [restrike]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is an image of an architectural scene. It shows a grand, columned corridor with a richly decorated ceiling, leading to an arched opening at the far end. Beyond the opening is a circular arrangement of arches and columns surrounding an open space. The perspective creates depth and symmetry, featuring detailed columns and architectural elements. The ceiling is adorned with ornamental designs, including scrolls and motifs. The structure displays classical architectural features such as Corinthian columns and a harmonious arrangement of lines and curves.

artworks.title: Torso of Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal
artworks.description: The image depicts a partly drawn man with both arms raised, head tilted back, and gaze directed upward. The man has long hair, a beard, and is wearing a cloth around his waist. The background is plain with an aged appearance.

artworks.title: The Eagle's Nest in the Forest of Fontainebleau (Le nid de l'aigle dans la Foret de Fontainebleau
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Joan Lees
artworks.description: The image shows a forest landscape with a path curving into the distance. A figure with a dog is walking along the path. The scene is under an overcast sky with dense foliage and tall trees. The artwork is done in an etching style with fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. The coloring is monochromatic in shades of grey and black, emphasizing light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Embroiderers (Les brodeuses)
artworks.medium: chine colle lithograph
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to margins): 16.7 x 21 cm (6 9/16 x 8 1/4 in.)
support: 26.7 x 36.1 cm (10 1/2 x 14 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Prentiss Taylor
artworks.description: Two women are seated at a table. The woman on the right is engrossed in a task, while the other woman sits with her back to the viewer. The woman on the right has long, dark hair pulled back and wears a dark dress with a white collar. The woman on the left has her dark hair styled in a loose bun. Both women are focused on objects on the table. The setting has a dark background.

artworks.title: Shepherds Peering into a Chasm
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Nicholas Brown, J. Carter Brown and Angela B. Fischer: Tenants in Common
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape of rolling hills with a line of hills in the middle ground. A small tower or structure is visible in the distance. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, using brown ink to render the scene in washes and faint outlines, creating an atmospheric quality. The color palette is sepia tones with varying intensities of brown. In the foreground, there are three figures with walking sticks in a rocky landscape. Sketched trees and a distant flock of birds are also visible.

artworks.title: Valley of the Lledr, North Wales (no.1)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view of a valley from an elevated position. The horizon is high in the composition, with distant hills fading into the sky. The etching features detailed brushstrokes defining cliffs and hills. A building is visible near dark foliage, next to a winding river or path, surrounded by trees and rocks. The color palette includes monochromatic shades of blacks and grays, emphasizing the contrast between dark and bright areas. The scene captures a tranquil, pastoral setting with natural contours and clear linear features.

artworks.title: On Lake Como
artworks.medium: etching in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a rustic building by a body of water. The perspective is slightly elevated. Details of the building's archway and the water's surface are visible. A hill and trees obstruct the horizon. The brushstrokes are detailed, emphasizing textures of foliage, architecture, and water. The color palette is sepia, creating a vintage feel. More buildings and greenery are visible in the distance, with a sky featuring soft clouds.

artworks.title: Sentinel Pine
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image features a single, tall pine tree against a background of sky and distant landscape. The tree is detailed with etched lines to depict its bark, needles, and branches. The color scheme is primarily black and gray, with clouds in the sky. Notable elements in the scene include water, land formations, rocks, and shrubbery.

artworks.title: Snow
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image displays a winter scene with trees and foliage covered in snow. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering a serene view of the landscape. The trees and shrubs are depicted using intricate etching techniques, with fine strokes creating a stark contrast against the white ground. The color palette is limited to black, white, and the natural tone of the paper. Dark snow patches or shadows on the ground add depth and texture to the artwork.

artworks.title: Palm Canyon (no.1)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image depicts a solitary palm tree in a rocky landscape. The tree is the central focus, surrounded by rugged rock formations. The sky forms a backdrop behind the tree, with vegetation sparse around its base. The artwork features precise etching with a monochromatic color palette of soft earthy tones.

artworks.title: Palo Verde Trees
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching in red on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an open space extending towards distant mountains. The horizon is at the lower third of the image, with swirling cloud formations filling the sky. Two trees are in the foreground, contrasting with the smooth land and distant ridges. The color palette consists of warm red tones of varying intensity, creating contrast in the scene.

artworks.title: Desert Sunset
artworks.medium: etching with plate tone in greenish-black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is low in the composition, with a valley below meeting distant mountains. The sky above has billowing clouds. The artwork features fine linework creating textural contrast between the terrain and clouds. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray emphasizing light across the landscape. The terrain in the foreground has rocky outcrops and layered rock formations. In the distance, sharp peaks rise towards the sky, with beams of light adding depth to the scene.
